result.fundName: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund - Regular Plan - Growth

insights: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund - Regular Plan - Growth decisively outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 3.72% (18.40% vs 14.68%).
Beat the benchmark in 100.0% of rolling windows — strong consistency for a Equity: Flexi Cap.
Risk-adjusted returns are superior: Sharpe 1.06 vs benchmark 0.63, Sortino 1.31.
Defensive profile: beta 0.60 with 26% lower volatility than the benchmark.
Positive alpha of 7.25% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.27).
Higher drawdown risk: fund max drawdown -31.26% vs benchmark -38.11%.
Rolling return range spans 3.45% to 32.77% (29.32 pp spread) — consistency score 100.
This fund satisfies all three Golden Triangle conditions.
